model_type: Deterministic Post-Processing & Medical Validation Layer (Philippine National Drug Formulary PNDF / RxNorm lookup with SymSpell phonetic distance matching & LASA safety engine)
deployment_location: Post-OCR validation pipeline on Client (expo-sqlite / in-memory trie) or Server (Node.js module)
privacy_compliance: 100% private and offline. Checks extracted tokens against a locally bundled medical dictionary with zero external network communication; fully compliant with HIPAA, GDPR, and Philippine DPA.
on_device_binary_size_impact: 3.5 MB to 6.5 MB. A compressed SQLite database or in-memory trie covering all ~5,200 active Philippine FDA/PNDF registered generic and brand entries adds negligible mobile footprint.
printed_label_accuracy: Substantial precision enhancer (+25% to +40% accuracy on medication names/strengths). Automatically corrects optical misreads (e.g., 'Metform1n 5OOmg' -> 'Metformin 500mg') to verified pharmaceutical entries.
handwriting_recognition: High disambiguation power. Evaluates ambiguous physician stroke candidates against valid clinical vocabulary, discarding phonetically impossible character combinations.
multilingual_code_switching_support: High. Maintains Philippine pharmaceutical brand registries (e.g., Biogesic, Neozep, Solmux, Alaxan) alongside international generic INN names, disambiguating them from surrounding Tagalog instructions.
curved_surface_and_glare_tolerance: High recovery capability. Uses prefix and fuzzy Levenshtein distance matching to reconstruct medication names truncated by bottle curvature or obscured by blister pack foil glare.
tabular_timetable_parsing: Clinical sanity enforcement. Cross-checks parsed timetable frequencies against standard clinical dosing limits, flagging impossible frequencies or conflicting intervals.
hallucination_under_degraded_input: Essential safety firewall. Any hallucinatory drug name generated by an upstream VLM or noisy OCR engine that does not match an authentic PNDF entry is flagged with a warning, forcing caregiver review.
latency_seconds: 0.002 to 0.015 seconds (2-15 ms) utilizing SymSpell symmetric delete fuzzy matching and SQLite FTS5 index.
ram_peak_footprint: 15 MB to 35 MB in-memory dictionary cache footprint.
cost_profile: 100% Free. Derived from Philippine Department of Health (DOH) open formulary data and open-source fuzzy matching libraries.
react_native_compatibility: Extremely High. Can be implemented as pure TypeScript in Alaga's client codebase (using expo-sqlite or typed trie) or integrated into the Node.js backend.
offline_readiness: 100% offline. Operates completely without internet connectivity in any rural or community environment.
structured_output_support: Direct schema enrichment. Ingests MedicationOcrDraft, standardizes genericName and brandName, normalizes strength/unit, and attaches clinical warnings for Look-Alike/Sound-Alike (LASA) risks.
formulary_grounding_readiness: 100% Native. Serves as the authoritative grounding anchor for all OCR and vision extraction pipelines in Alaga.
